question: Su'aal
defaultDirections: Dooro jawaabta aad u malaynayso inay ka jawaabayso su'aasha. Markaad dhammayso, riix {checkAnswer}. Waxaad heli doontaa jawaab-celin muujinaysa saxnaanta jawaabtaada iyo sida loo sii socdo.
answerRequiresCorrection: Jawaabtu waxay u baahan tahay sixid

keyboardDirections: Kiiboodh: u gudub sawirka, ku dhaqaaji calaamadda furayaasha fallaadhaha (qabo Shift si aad tallaabooyin waaweyn u qaaddo), kadibna riix Enter ama Space si aad meeshaas u doorato.
missLimitDirections: Waxaad seegi kartaa {max} jeer ka hor inta uusan isku daygu dhammaan.

stageKeys: Isticmaal furayaasha fallaadhaha si aad u dhaqaajiso calaamadda, Shift si aad tallaabooyin waaweyn u qaaddo, Enter ama Space si aad meeshaas u doorato.
lastMiss: Taasi waxay ahayd seegistii ugu dambeysay ee la oggolaa.
revealedNote: Xariiqyada go'go'an ayaa muujinaya waxa aad seegtay: {names}.
